about_the_game:
About the Game

NINDO Guardian of the Starlit Shadow is a ninja-themed roguelike deckbuilding game set in a beautifully stylized Japanese world.
Face powerful enemies, grow through choices, and craft your own unique path of strategy and strength.

Key Features

🖼️ Striking Visuals: Anime Meets Traditional Japan
Explore a vivid world where classic Japanese aesthetics blend with colorful anime-style visuals. Unique characters and enemies bring this world to life.

🃏 Deckbuilding with Tactical Depth
Choose new cards after each battle to strengthen your deck. Use ninjutsu, martial arts, and ultimate techniques to outsmart your foes.

🔁 Roguelite Replayability
Each dungeon run offers new encounters and events. Learn from defeat, grow stronger, and dive back into the challenge.

📖 Storytelling through Flavor Text
Discover the pasts and fates of the ninja through the rich flavor text on cards and items.

Gameplay Flow

  • Traverse procedurally generated maps filled with battles and events

  • Play cards strategically to defeat your enemies

  • Strengthen your deck with new cards, items, and gear

Forge your own NINDO — the way of the ninja.
🎮 Play the free demo now and get a taste of what's to come!
🛒 Add to your wishlist so you won't miss the official release!

Supported Languages

  • Japanese (Full Support)

  • English (Translated)

  • Chinese (Simplified & Traditional)

Development Roadmap

🛠 Currently in development for Early Access
🔄 Regular updates planned with new cards and features
🤝 Community feedback is welcome — help shape the future of NINDO!
